t: What Repeatable Read Internals Is All About
title: What Repeatable Read Internals Is All About
description: Transaction-level snapshots: the same SELECT returns the same rows all transaction long.. This database covers Repeatable Read Internals with full records: definitions, key facts, working procedures, and runnable demo programs, arranged on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced. Isolation levels define which anomalies are possible.
definition: Repeatable Read Internals — Transaction-level snapshots: the same SELECT returns the same rows all transaction long.
key_points: Isolation levels define which anomalies are possible.
Read-uncommitted allows dirty reads; almost never use it.
Read-committed is the default; each statement sees committed data.
Repeatable-read gives transaction snapshots; phantoms vary by engine.
